question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Flick through the

P. image gallery on your phone, or fast forward

Q. with little or no effort on your part

R. how the briefly presented images trigger memories

S. through a previously watched movie, and notice
solution:
The correct order is **PSRQ**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **P. "image gallery on your phone, or fast forward****" **- This part introduces the action of flicking through the image gallery on your phone, which implies quickly browsing or looking through.
 
• **S. "through a previously watched movie, and notice"** - This part introduces another action, which is watching a previously seen movie. It implies that while watching, one might notice something specific.
